why: FKT line (trail past Lake Metan to Stujack Pass, then Knife's Edge and hands-on scramble to the summit) matches WTA's description of the Pugh route and our Stujack Pass scramble.
The FKT standard SE trail route requires the Haystack scramble to the true summit, and WTA confirms the Mount Si Trail plus a scramble to the Haystack as the summit route.
